title: Verdict of a2dlc check (.a2dlc/verdict.json, not committed)
description: aggregate verdict: FAIL if any target or test FAILs without a waiver (a target FAIL with a counterexample on code outside config.critical_code is a note, targets[].note, and does not count); otherwise INCONCLUSIVE if any is, a gate could not run, or some changed line in scope was left unexamined (coverage.files[].uncovered not empty: never an empty PASS; lines in coverage.files[].noted do not count); otherwise PASS. A FAIL with a waiver, approved or pending, does not count, but the pending one goes to pending_waivers and verify blocks it.

tree_hash.description: git write-tree of a temporary index without the gate outputs and with .a2dlc/waivers.json

stage.description: v2, optional: the a2dlc run stage that emitted the verdict (run-state id, today "4"). Absent in a2dlc check.

contract_hash.description: v2, optional: sha256 of .a2dlc/run/<slice>/contract.json (S*) when the run has a contract. It ties the verdict to the contract it was judged against: another S* asks for another verdict.

note.description: A FAIL target with a counterexample, no waiver, on code that config.critical_code does not name: it stays in the receipt with its counterexample and does not count toward the verdict. Absent otherwise and in receipts from before it existed. Its own category, apart from coverage.files[].noted. verify refuses a note on critical code.

engine_errors.description: Engines that did not respond or responded badly: their files have no target and the aggregate verdict is INCONCLUSIVE.

diff_budget.description: Per-diff time budget of the engines, in seconds. Functions not run because the budget ran out are listed in cut with a reason, never omitted: each one is a target this verdict did not judge.

test_gates.description: What happened with each test gate (config.tests). What does not run stays in view, never silently.

tests_diff.description: N trees: the same T over the base, the candidate and each --peer. not_applicable without --peer or --tests-overlay, or with an empty T.

equivalence_s.description: N=2 differential: candidate against candidate on the same inputs (Stage 4 with two builders). not_applicable with one candidate.

coverage.description: Coverage precondition over the changed files in scope (engine paths and tests.source_paths). Per file, which changed lines a PASS/FAIL target examined (by_engine), which ones some test ran on the candidate (covered), and which nobody looked at (uncovered). Of those, the ones an engine recognised as a defensive exception handler or declaration-only code move to noted. Lines that coverage does not list as statements do not appear.

status.description: ran: some run on the candidate produced coverage. unavailable: config.tests exists but no command left $A2DLC_COVERAGE. not_configured: no config.tests. In the last two only the engines examine.

reason.description: Why there was no coverage: unavailable, e.g. the report could not be read; or not_configured while the candidate's config adds a tests block the base lacks (check judges with the base's config, so the block takes effect once it is in the base).

noted.description: Lines that no engine examined and no test executed but that the engine recognised as a defensive exception handler or as declaration-only code. The receipt states them and they do not block: they are not in uncovered. Absent when nothing was classified (older receipts, an engine without the operation).

tests.description: Testcases the gates judged. aggregate verdict: a FAIL or INCONCLUSIVE without a waiver of its class counts as a target's.

base.description: nop_oracle: state on the base with stubs and the candidate's tests. baseline and tests_diff: state on the base.

trees.description: tests_diff: state of the test in each tree (base, candidate, peer:<short sha>).

origin.description: tests_diff: which tree the test file came from (candidate, peer:<short sha>, overlay). nop_oracle: "overlay" when the test was brought by --tests-overlay (the Saboteur) and not the candidate.

message.description: Message of the failure it decided on, trimmed.

characterization.description: Passes on the base and the change does not declare an intent to change behavior (no enforce_new_behavior stubs or waivers): it is recorded and does not block.

flaky.description: Flaky on the base on re-runs: does not block; quarantine is proposed.

checks.description: Pluggable deterministic checks (config.checks, protocol §5 Checks, ADR meta/0006), in config order; what did not run stays in view, never silently. A check lowers the verdict, never raises it: blocking with an unwaived finding counts as FAIL; blocking in error or timeout counts as INCONCLUSIVE; advisory is recorded only.

status.description: ran: the image ran and wrote a valid response. not_applicable: 0 of the changed files match its globs (the count goes in reason), or the check said so. not_configured: a stage fired it and no check binds to that stage. error: missing image, non-zero exit, missing or invalid response (never a pass). timeout: past timeout_s (never a pass).

pass.description: Only when it ran; false whenever there is a finding.

waived.description: A waiver accept_finding on this target exists; it needs a signature to count on verify.

status.description: ran: it ran. not_applicable: nothing to judge (no changed tests, or no changed sources or tests). not_configured: config.tests or baseline_command is missing. error: it could not run (counts as INCONCLUSIVE).

cached.description: baseline: the base run came from the cache (same base, same selection).

stubs.description: nop_oracle: symbols that received a stub on the base.

trees.description: tests_diff: trees on which T ran, in order.
